testsuite.name: gRPC — unary, streaming, metadata and the error path

testcase.name: unary — one request, one response

failure.message: js failed: ========== Code: session.pop() Error: Index 0 out of bounds for length 0 ==========

testcase.failure: * session = karate.channel('grpc') * = '/proto/hello.proto' * = 'HelloService' * = 'Hello' * session.send({ name: 'John' }) * session.pop() == { message: 'hello John' }

testcase.name: request metadata, and reading the response metadata back

failure.message: js failed: ========== Code: session.pop() Error: Index 0 out of bounds for length 0 ==========

testcase.name: the error path — an empty name is rejected
testcase.failure: * session = karate.channel('grpc') * = '/proto/hello.proto' * = 'HelloService' * = 'Hello' * session.send({ name: '' }) * session.collect() == [] * session.status == 'INVALID_ARGUMENT'

testcase.name: server streaming — collect a known number of responses

failure.message: match failed: EQUALS $ | not equal | actual array length is not equal to expected - 0:3 (LIST:LIST) [] [{"message":"hello John 1"},{"message":"hello John 2"},{"message":"hello John 3"}]

testcase.failure: * session = karate.channel('grpc') * = '/proto/hello.proto' * = 'HelloService' * = 'LotsOfReplies' * = 3 * session.send({ name: 'John' }) * session.collect() == [{ message: 'hello John 1' }, { message: 'hello John 2' }, { message: 'hello John 3' }]

testcase.name: client streaming — many requests, one response

failure.message: js failed: ========== Code: session.pop() Error: Index 0 out of bounds for length 0 ==========

testcase.failure: * session = karate.channel('grpc') * = '/proto/hello.proto' * = 'HelloService' * = 'LotsOfGreetings' * = true * session.send({ name: 'John' }) * session.send({ name: 'Smith' }) * session.flush() * session.pop() == { message: 'hello [John, Smith]' }

testcase.name: bidirectional streaming — a response per request on one open stream

failure.message: match failed: EQUALS $ | not equal | actual array length is not equal to expected - 0:3 (LIST:LIST) [] [{"message":"hello [John]"},{"message":"hello [John, Smith]"},{"message":"hello [John, Smith, Jane]"}]
